modifiers.name: Sensory Deprivation
modifiers.description: The active player must wear a blindfold or keep their eyes closed for the next turn.

modifiers.name: Temperature Play
modifiers.description: Incorporate ice or a warm touch element during the next rent task or challenge.

modifiers.name: Restrained Elegance
modifiers.description: Hands must remain gently held behind the back or bound during the next action.

modifiers.name: Whisper Only
modifiers.description: All speech must be delivered in a low whisper directly into your partner's ear until your next turn.

modifiers.name: Extended Duration
modifiers.description: Double the duration or repetitions required for your next completed task.

modifiers.name: Feather Touch
modifiers.description: Use a feather, soft fabric, or fingertips with minimal pressure for all touches during this round.

modifiers.name: Mirror Image
modifiers.description: Your partner must mimic every movement you perform during your task.

modifiers.name: Heat Surge
modifiers.description: Gain +2 Heat currency immediately instead of holding this card.
